title: toolbox hub op script
features:
1. Core Automation Features

These features handle the repetitive tasks required to build and maintain a tycoon.

Auto Buy: Automatically detects and purchases available items in your tycoon as they become available.

Auto Upgrade: Automatically handles the upgrading process for your tycoon's assets up to level 100.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically triggers the "Rebirth" function for your tycoon, allowing you to reset for bonuses without manual input.

2. Farming & Resource Management

These tools help you gather currency or items found around the game map.

Auto Lemon (Fruit Collection): Automatically teleports your character to "LemonTree" objects and uses the ClickDetector to collect fruit. It also disables collision on these trees to ensure smooth movement.

Auto Collect Bags: Automatically detects and teleports the character to money bags or cash items dropped around the map to collect them quickly.

Auto Phone Deals: Scans the in-game phone interface and automatically accepts deals/options provided by the game, saving you from manually clicking through the menus.

3. Utility & Navigation

Teleport System: Provides a pre-configured list of fast-travel buttons to key locations, including:

Points of Interest: Vine Key, Vine Door, Exit Sewers, UFO Key, Alien, and Void Altar.

Base Return: A dedicated button to teleport you back to your starting tycoon location.

Anti-AFK: Includes logic to detect if the game is about to kick you for being idle, simulating user input (moving/jumping) to keep you active.

Auto Rejoin: Attempts to automatically reconnect you to the server if the game errors or crashes.

4. User Interface & Tracking

Key System: A security layer requiring a specific key to unlock the full menu, with a quick-link button to join a Discord server.

Monitoring GUI: An on-screen status monitor that tracks:

Current FPS.

Real-time Cash count.

Statistics of actions performed (Total buys, upgrades, rebirths, and phone deals).

Visual indicators (ON/OFF) for all active automation toggles.

Customizability: The interface is fully draggable and contains organized tabs (Main, Farm, Teleports) for easy navigation.
